description: Propose an amendment to a charter. Supplies a full replacement CharterCore, not a patch. The SDK derives the signing preimage and produces the proposer signature. Session state is not an authoritative registry: amendments live only in this process, are lost on restart, and carry no external trust.

effective_at.description: ISO 8601, when the amendment takes effect if approved
